subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + conditional bridge letter for renewal / expansion
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@vertexhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter needed for renewal (PO timeline May 15)

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing the purchase order for an expansion of our Redwood deployment and our procurement/legal teams require the most recent SOC 2 Type II report plus a temporary bridge or attestation to cover the period until your next auditor’s report is available.

Key constraints from procurement: PO target date 2026-05-15; they need evidence that our audit coverage won’t have a material gap after the current period ends (2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31). If a bridge letter or interim attestation is possible, we need a signed copy before the PO is approved.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can provide a redacted Type II report we can share with procurement/legal?
- If a bridge/temporary attestation is supported and who signs it (internal compliance vs. independent auditor)?
- An approximate timeline for delivery — procurement will not move forward without at least the draft bridge in hand.

Also, procurement will run a short SIG assessment; can you point us to the best contact for CAIQ/SIG artifacts?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Security & Compliance
Vertex Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter needed for renewal (PO timeline May 15)

Thanks for the note, Elena — and congrats on the expansion signal. We can support this; below is the plan and owners.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (we redact client-identifying appendix).
- We can issue a bridge letter (signed by our Head of Security and Counsels' office) that attests to continuous controls coverage; note this is an in-house attestation, not a newly issued Type II by the auditor.
- Timeline: draft bridge by 2026-05-04, internal legal sign-off by 2026-05-07, final signed copy by 2026-05-10. Redacted SOC2 PDF available by 2026-05-06.

Dev — can you own producing the bridge draft and the evidence checklist for Vertex’s SIG/CAIQ? Grace, looping you for procurement coordination and any pricing/contract commentary.

Elena — we’ll include a short cover memo that explains scope and the audit period covered (2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31) and call out how our next audit maps onto that window. If procurement needs a Q&A, we can also provide an answered SIG questionnaire export.

If you want the draft earlier than May 4, say so and we’ll try to accelerate.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

On Thu, Apr 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Dev — can you own producing the bridge draft and the evidence checklist for Vertex’s SIG/CAIQ?

Yep — happy to take this. I’ve started a working draft and attached three artifacts for initial review: a redacted SOC 2 Type II (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf), a bridge letter draft (bridge_letter_draft_Redwood_v1.docx), and an evidence checklist for procurement (evidence_checklist_procurement_v1.xlsx).

Notes and constraints:
- The bridge letter we propose is a controls-continuity attestation that our Head of Security will sign; per legal, we cannot present that as an auditor-issued 'Type II' — procurement/legal typically accept a vendor-signed bridge plus the most recent Type II.
- For SIG/CAIQ, we can provide an answered export but will initially flag the items requiring supporting artifacts (maps to the attached checklist).
- If Vertex requests the auditor to issue a formal incremental Type II, that will take longer (multi-week engagement). For PO timing, the bridge + redacted report is the fastest path.

Next steps (timeline):
- 2026-05-02: internal legal review of bridge wording
- 2026-05-04: deliver draft bridge + answered SIG export
- 2026-05-06: share redacted Type II PDF
- 2026-05-10: return signed bridge letter (if legal approves)

Grace — once legal OKs, I’ll upload the DocuSign envelope (link below) and attach to the HubSpot deal for tracking.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf; bridge_letter_draft_Redwood_v1.docx; evidence_checklist_procurement_v1.xlsx

- Can the bridge letter explicitly state the date range it covers and reference the auditor report we will receive (redacted SOC2)? We prefer date clarity in the wording.
- Procurement asked if your legal team can pre-approve minor edits to the letter so we can avoid back-and-forth on signature day.
